summary: Overlord entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Overlord
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC release with Raising Hell expansion available

emulation.notes: Use native PC route; console routes only for comparison.

primary.version: Overlord plus Raising Hell expansion / current PC release
primary.why: Overlord's best archive route is PC with the Raising Hell expansion available, because it preserves the original game and adds the major expansion content while keeping high-quality capture and control flexibility.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Steam/GOG PC release with Raising Hell installed or available. Record storefront, patch, controller/keyboard setup, difficulty, corruption choices, expansion progress, minion upgrades, and whether Xbox 360 or PS3 Raising Hell routes were compared.

secondary.why: PC is the complete/capture route when the expansion is included.

secondary.exclusive_content: Console version bundled with expansion content
secondary.what_to_play: Use if documenting PS3-specific performance/control context.
secondary.why: It is a complete console route, but PC remains the capture target.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record whether Raising Hell is installed; do not merge with Overlord II or later spin-offs.
